messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency SLO breach on /v1/stream (region: us-east-1). Routing: streaming-route-prod. Trigger: sustained 30m above SLO. Pager sent to #incidents and @ops_oncall :rotating_light:
emily: Ack. I'm looking at traces now. Seeing tail latency spikes starting ~30m ago correlated with prompt-assembly svc (svc-prompt-assembly). ETA 5–10m for initial triage.
raj: Adding context — we rolled out prompt-template v2.1 to production ~40m ago (canary -> 50% -> 100%). That change changed how tool schemas are hydrated into templates.
mia: p95 jumped from 120ms -> 460ms, p99 is ~2.1s on streaming requests. Non-stream (sync) latencies slightly elevated too. Here's a quick metric dump:
```
metric: latencies.v1_streaming.route=streaming-route-prod
p50: 85ms
p95: 460ms (was 120ms)
p99: 2.1s (was 340ms)
error-rate: 0.6% (baseline 0.1%)
concurrent: +24% from baseline
```
raj: Also seeing elevated CPU on prompt-assembly hosts >85% and tokenizer-worker queues growing.
emily: Logs show repeated template expansion for large tool schemas, many requests hitting JSON-mode parsing branch. Sample request payload (redacted):
```
{"prompt_template": "{{call_tool(user_tool)}}", "tool_schema": "{...nested schema ~30kb...}", "mode": "json"}
```
ops_oncall: I'm on it. Starting immediate mitigations: 1) scale up prompt-assembly ASG +1 instance type; 2) move streaming-route-prod to router fallback that forces non-streaming path for heavy requests; 3) add temporary per-customer qps cap for the top-3 callers. Will report back in 5m.
dave: If template v2.1 is the cause we can roll it back. I've opened a revert PR but holding until ops confirms mitigation efficacy. PR: `github.com/redwood/infra/pulls/4321`
olga: Quick note — JSON-mode does deep validation currently, and there's no limit on recursive tool-schema expansion. We should add a cheap guard: max expansion depth + short-circuit cache hit for repeated schemas. Can push a hotfix to patch validation to be O(1) for known shapes.
emily: Observability: traces show the majority of p99 tail spent in `hydrate_tool_schema()` and `tokenizer.normalize()`; tokenizer CPU spikes when input schema length > 10k chars.
mia: Streaming stalls specifically: clients see initial tokens then stall ~800–1200ms repeatedly; likely due to blocking prompt assembly before streaming flush.
ops_oncall: Mitigations done — ASG scaled, router fallback applied, per-customer caps applied, and we enabled prefix cache for prompt templates. Early signal: p95 dropped to ~230ms, p99 down to ~1.1s. Still above SLO but improving.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: customer-facing impact: some streaming responses experienced delayed tails and partial stalls for ~35m for ~4% of streaming requests in us-east-1. No data exfil detected. Status: mitigated -> partial recovery.
dave: Rolled back prompt-template v2.1 in canary and stopped ramp. Traffic to canary is now 0%. Monitoring for regressions.
olga: Pushed a tiny guard patch limiting `max_template_expansion_chars=8192` and short-circuiting on repeated schema fingerprints — deploy to prod-ops now.
azp-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment started: infra/guard-patch@hotfix-981 -> prod (step 1/3).
ops_oncall: Deployed guard patch, no immediate errors. Observability shows template expansion CPU cost per request reduced by ~40% after guard.
emily: Customer impact assessment checklist:
- affected routes: /v1/stream (us-east-1)
- % requests affected: peak ~4%, sustained ~1.1% during mitigation window
- severity: medium (SLO breach, some user-facing stalls)
- RCA hypothesis: prompt-template v2.1 + unbounded tool-schema expansion triggered heavy tokenizer/validation work in JSON mode causing tail latency + streaming stalls.
raj: Followups (short term): 1) Add per-request template-expansion timeout (200ms) and fallback to safe distilled prompt; 2) Re-introduce v2.1 after adding guarded expansion; 3) Ramp tests with synthetic large schemas.
mia: Followups (long term): 1) Add telemetry to attribute latency to schema-size at request ingest; 2) Implement schema fingerprint cache at ingress (memoize hydration results); 3) Add regression eval for big tool-schemas to Redwood Optimize.
dave: I've linked a postmortem draft and action items in drive: `drive.redwood/incident/4570001234/postmortem-draft` — will fill details tomorrow.
ops_oncall: Handoff to next on-call in 30m. Current status: routing fallback still on; guard-patch deployed; autoscale stabilized. If p99 remains >1.5s after full traffic ramp, escalate to eng-runtime.
olga: I'm labeling the PRs: `hotfix/guard-template`, `revert/v2.1`, and `telemetry/schema-size`.
emily: Thanks all. Final note for release and runbook updates: add a step in templating runbook to check schema size and JSON-mode path before full rollout.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: resolved -> monitoring. If regressions occur reopen with thread_ts 4570001234. :white_check_mark:
